### _The Fosters: Girls United_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_The_Fosters_episodes&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: The Fosters: Girls United")]

At the start of the second part of the first season of _The Fosters_, a five-episode [web series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_series "Web series") called _The Fosters: Girls United_ was confirmed by [ABC Family](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABC_Family "ABC Family"). It stars [Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell"), Daffany Clark, Cherinda Kincherlow, [Annamarie Kenoyer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annamarie_Kenoyer "Annamarie Kenoyer"), [Alicia Sixtos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alicia_Sixtos "Alicia Sixtos"), [Hayley Kiyoko](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayley_Kiyoko "Hayley Kiyoko"), and Angela Gibbs. _Girls United_ premiered on ABC Family's official [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") account on February 3, 2014.[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_The_Fosters_episodes#cite_note-104) Each episode runs approximately 5 minutes long.

| No. | Title | Originally posted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | "Run Baby Run" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi goes missing and Girls United counselor, Michelle, calls a meeting to ask if the girls know anything about where she may have run off to. |
| 2 | "Stab in the Back" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| The girls discuss who of them can be pregnant. |
| 3 | "Got Your Back" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Callie and Kiara share some mutual secrets. Callie also discovers that Becka harms herself with a knife. |
| 4 | "Scorpion Kings" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi's father visits the Girls United home for some information about Gabi. |
| 5 | "United We Stand" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi comes back and reveals she went away because she has HIV. |

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

_[The Fosters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Fosters\_(American\_TV\_series) "The Fosters (American TV series)")_ is an American drama series which aired on [Freeform](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Freeform_(TV_channel) "Freeform (TV channel)") (formerly ABC Family) from June 3, 2013, to June 6, 2018.

A total of 104 episodes were broadcast over five seasons.

### _The Fosters: Girls United_

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_The_Fosters_episodes&action=edit&section=9 "Edit section: The Fosters: Girls United")]

At the start of the second part of the first season of _The Fosters_, a five-episode [web series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_series "Web series") called _The Fosters: Girls United_ was confirmed by [ABC Family](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ABC_Family "ABC Family"). It stars [Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell"), Daffany Clark, Cherinda Kincherlow, [Annamarie Kenoyer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Annamarie_Kenoyer "Annamarie Kenoyer"), [Alicia Sixtos](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alicia_Sixtos "Alicia Sixtos"), [Hayley Kiyoko](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayley_Kiyoko "Hayley Kiyoko"), and Angela Gibbs. _Girls United_ premiered on ABC Family's official [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube") account on February 3, 2014.[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_The_Fosters_episodes#cite_note-104) Each episode runs approximately 5 minutes long.

| No. | Title | Originally posted |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | "Run Baby Run" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi goes missing and Girls United counselor, Michelle, calls a meeting to ask if the girls know anything about where she may have run off to. |
| 2 | "Stab in the Back" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| The girls discuss who of them can be pregnant. |
| 3 | "Got Your Back" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Callie and Kiara share some mutual secrets. Callie also discovers that Becka harms herself with a knife. |
| 4 | "Scorpion Kings" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi's father visits the Girls United home for some information about Gabi. |
| 5 | "United We Stand" | February 3,2014(2014-02-03) |
| Gabi comes back and reveals she went away because she has HIV. |

The fourth season of _[The Fosters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Fosters\_(American\_TV\_series) "The Fosters (American TV series)")_ premiered on June 20, 2016 and ended on April 11, 2017. The season consisted of 20 episodes and stars [Teri Polo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teri_Polo "Teri Polo") and [Sherri Saum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherri_Saum "Sherri Saum") as Stef Foster and Lena Adams, an interracial lesbian couple, who foster a girl, Callie ([Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell")) and her younger brother, Jude ([Hayden Byerly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayden_Byerly "Hayden Byerly")) while also trying to juggle raising [Latino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans "Hispanic and Latino Americans") twin teenagers, Mariana and Jesus ([Cierra Ramirez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cierra_Ramirez "Cierra Ramirez") and [Noah Centineo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noah_Centineo "Noah Centineo")), and Stef's biological son, Brandon ([David Lambert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lambert_(actor) "David Lambert (actor)")).

## Premise

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fosters_season_4&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Premise")]

In this season, the fallout of the tryst between Brandon and Callie continues. After getting suspended from school Callie meets and makes a new friend in Aaron ([Elliot Fletcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elliot_Fletcher "Elliot Fletcher")). They team up to find out what happened to an old foster brother of hers after being convicted of a murder 4 years earlier, and go down a dangerous path that's filled with unwanted surprises. Callie later gets charged with a hit run felony and spends time in juvie. Because of her age the DA is charging her as and adult and she may be sent to prison.

Lena's parents have financial issues and it threatens to force Stef and Lena to sell the house.

Jesus and Emma begin a strictly sexual relationship, and are considering getting back together. Jesus suffers from two [TBIs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traumatic_brain_injury "Traumatic brain injury"), first by a nail gun then later being assaulted. Jesus need full time care and Lena takes time off to care for him.

Jude starts spending more time with Noah ([Kalama Epstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalama_Epstein "Kalama Epstein")), an avid gay churchgoing [Christians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christians "Christians") who has a wild side. Noah introduces Jude to drugs.

Mariana struggles to let go of Nick ([Louis Hunter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Hunter "Louis Hunter")) after the incident at school. Mariana also struggles with the fact that Ana is now sober and is a caring mother to her baby sister.

Avoiding the rath of his mothers Brandon moves in with a single mom but finds parenthood a struggle. He goes to desperate measures in order to secure his place in [Juilliard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juilliard_School "Juilliard School"), which eventually backfires on him bigtime.

Stef gets promoted to detective and finds the role challenging. Meanwhile, offering to adopt AJ, Mike struggles with fatherhood while dealing with his girlfriend, Ana.

The fourth season of _[The Fosters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Fosters\_(American\_TV\_series) "The Fosters (American TV series)")_ premiered on June 20, 2016 and ended on April 11, 2017. The season consisted of 20 episodes and stars [Teri Polo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teri_Polo "Teri Polo") and [Sherri Saum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherri_Saum "Sherri Saum") as Stef Foster and Lena Adams, an interracial lesbian couple, who foster a girl, Callie ([Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell")) and her younger brother, Jude ([Hayden Byerly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayden_Byerly "Hayden Byerly")) while also trying to juggle raising [Latino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans "Hispanic and Latino Americans") twin teenagers, Mariana and Jesus ([Cierra Ramirez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cierra_Ramirez "Cierra Ramirez") and [Noah Centineo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noah_Centineo "Noah Centineo")), and Stef's biological son, Brandon ([David Lambert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lambert_(actor) "David Lambert (actor)")).

## Premise

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fosters_season_4&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Premise")]

In this season, the fallout of the tryst between Brandon and Callie continues. After getting suspended from school Callie meets and makes a new friend in Aaron ([Elliot Fletcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elliot_Fletcher "Elliot Fletcher")). They team up to find out what happened to an old foster brother of hers after being convicted of a murder 4 years earlier, and go down a dangerous path that's filled with unwanted surprises. Callie later gets charged with a hit run felony and spends time in juvie. Because of her age the DA is charging her as and adult and she may be sent to prison.

Lena's parents have financial issues and it threatens to force Stef and Lena to sell the house.

Jesus and Emma begin a strictly sexual relationship, and are considering getting back together. Jesus suffers from two [TBIs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traumatic_brain_injury "Traumatic brain injury"), first by a nail gun then later being assaulted. Jesus need full time care and Lena takes time off to care for him.

Jude starts spending more time with Noah ([Kalama Epstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalama_Epstein "Kalama Epstein")), an avid gay churchgoing [Christians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christians "Christians") who has a wild side. Noah introduces Jude to drugs.

Mariana struggles to let go of Nick ([Louis Hunter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Hunter "Louis Hunter")) after the incident at school. Mariana also struggles with the fact that Ana is now sober and is a caring mother to her baby sister.

Avoiding the rath of his mothers Brandon moves in with a single mom but finds parenthood a struggle. He goes to desperate measures in order to secure his place in [Juilliard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juilliard_School "Juilliard School"), which eventually backfires on him bigtime.

Stef gets promoted to detective and finds the role challenging. Meanwhile, offering to adopt AJ, Mike struggles with fatherhood while dealing with his girlfriend, Ana.

The fourth season of _[The Fosters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Fosters\_(American\_TV\_series) "The Fosters (American TV series)")_ premiered on June 20, 2016 and ended on April 11, 2017. The season consisted of 20 episodes and stars [Teri Polo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teri_Polo "Teri Polo") and [Sherri Saum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherri_Saum "Sherri Saum") as Stef Foster and Lena Adams, an interracial lesbian couple, who foster a girl, Callie ([Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell")) and her younger brother, Jude ([Hayden Byerly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayden_Byerly "Hayden Byerly")) while also trying to juggle raising [Latino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans "Hispanic and Latino Americans") twin teenagers, Mariana and Jesus ([Cierra Ramirez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cierra_Ramirez "Cierra Ramirez") and [Noah Centineo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noah_Centineo "Noah Centineo")), and Stef's biological son, Brandon ([David Lambert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lambert_(actor) "David Lambert (actor)")).

## Premise

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fosters_season_4&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Premise")]

In this season, the fallout of the tryst between Brandon and Callie continues. After getting suspended from school Callie meets and makes a new friend in Aaron ([Elliot Fletcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elliot_Fletcher "Elliot Fletcher")). They team up to find out what happened to an old foster brother of hers after being convicted of a murder 4 years earlier, and go down a dangerous path that's filled with unwanted surprises. Callie later gets charged with a hit run felony and spends time in juvie. Because of her age the DA is charging her as and adult and she may be sent to prison.

Lena's parents have financial issues and it threatens to force Stef and Lena to sell the house.

Jesus and Emma begin a strictly sexual relationship, and are considering getting back together. Jesus suffers from two [TBIs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traumatic_brain_injury "Traumatic brain injury"), first by a nail gun then later being assaulted. Jesus need full time care and Lena takes time off to care for him.

Jude starts spending more time with Noah ([Kalama Epstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalama_Epstein "Kalama Epstein")), an avid gay churchgoing [Christians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christians "Christians") who has a wild side. Noah introduces Jude to drugs.

Mariana struggles to let go of Nick ([Louis Hunter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Hunter "Louis Hunter")) after the incident at school. Mariana also struggles with the fact that Ana is now sober and is a caring mother to her baby sister.

Avoiding the rath of his mothers Brandon moves in with a single mom but finds parenthood a struggle. He goes to desperate measures in order to secure his place in [Juilliard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juilliard_School "Juilliard School"), which eventually backfires on him bigtime.

Stef gets promoted to detective and finds the role challenging. Meanwhile, offering to adopt AJ, Mike struggles with fatherhood while dealing with his girlfriend, Ana.

The fourth season of _[The Fosters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The\_Fosters\_(American\_TV\_series) "The Fosters (American TV series)")_ premiered on June 20, 2016 and ended on April 11, 2017. The season consisted of 20 episodes and stars [Teri Polo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Teri_Polo "Teri Polo") and [Sherri Saum](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sherri_Saum "Sherri Saum") as Stef Foster and Lena Adams, an interracial lesbian couple, who foster a girl, Callie ([Maia Mitchell](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maia_Mitchell "Maia Mitchell")) and her younger brother, Jude ([Hayden Byerly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hayden_Byerly "Hayden Byerly")) while also trying to juggle raising [Latino](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hispanic_and_Latino_Americans "Hispanic and Latino Americans") twin teenagers, Mariana and Jesus ([Cierra Ramirez](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cierra_Ramirez "Cierra Ramirez") and [Noah Centineo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Noah_Centineo "Noah Centineo")), and Stef's biological son, Brandon ([David Lambert](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Lambert_(actor) "David Lambert (actor)")).

## Premise

[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=The_Fosters_season_4&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Premise")]

In this season, the fallout of the tryst between Brandon and Callie continues. After getting suspended from school Callie meets and makes a new friend in Aaron ([Elliot Fletcher](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elliot_Fletcher "Elliot Fletcher")). They team up to find out what happened to an old foster brother of hers after being convicted of a murder 4 years earlier, and go down a dangerous path that's filled with unwanted surprises. Callie later gets charged with a hit run felony and spends time in juvie. Because of her age the DA is charging her as and adult and she may be sent to prison.

Lena's parents have financial issues and it threatens to force Stef and Lena to sell the house.

Jesus and Emma begin a strictly sexual relationship, and are considering getting back together. Jesus suffers from two [TBIs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Traumatic_brain_injury "Traumatic brain injury"), first by a nail gun then later being assaulted. Jesus need full time care and Lena takes time off to care for him.

Jude starts spending more time with Noah ([Kalama Epstein](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kalama_Epstein "Kalama Epstein")), an avid gay churchgoing [Christians](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christians "Christians") who has a wild side. Noah introduces Jude to drugs.

Mariana struggles to let go of Nick ([Louis Hunter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Louis_Hunter "Louis Hunter")) after the incident at school. Mariana also struggles with the fact that Ana is now sober and is a caring mother to her baby sister.

Avoiding the rath of his mothers Brandon moves in with a single mom but finds parenthood a struggle. He goes to desperate measures in order to secure his place in [Juilliard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Juilliard_School "Juilliard School"), which eventually backfires on him bigtime.

Stef gets promoted to detective and finds the role challenging. Meanwhile, offering to adopt AJ, Mike struggles with fatherhood while dealing with his girlfriend, Ana.

A Fraternity chapter in general is the lodge-base organizational structure of a fraternity. In [Tau Gamma Phi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tau_Gamma_Phi "Tau Gamma Phi"), the Chapter is the basic organizational structure of the fraternity. A Tau Gamma Phi Chapter or better called as Triskelion Chapter is the base organization of the Fraternity as a whole. This is where the fraternal activities and events happen, where the recruitment starts until an individual becomes a full-pledge member or the so-called full-pledge Triskelion. Each Triskelion Chapter is autonomous and is guided by City/Municipal Council and Provincial Council up to the Regional Council and/or Metropolitan Council they belong, thus, every individual Triskelion has a Chapter of origin where they came from. A Tau Gamma Phi member can also have an affiliated Chapter or Welcoming Chapter where each must comply with the residency requirements and Welcome Rites of the Welcoming Chapter. The difference of the basic Chapter from any other organizational body, is that the Chapters are source of decision in terms of governance, activities, man-power and initial resources

A Fraternity chapter in general is the lodge-base organizational structure of a fraternity. In [Tau Gamma Phi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tau_Gamma_Phi "Tau Gamma Phi"), the Chapter is the basic organizational structure of the fraternity. A Tau Gamma Phi Chapter or better called as Triskelion Chapter is the base organization of the Fraternity as a whole. This is where the fraternal activities and events happen, where the recruitment starts until an individual becomes a full-pledge member or the so-called full-pledge Triskelion. Each Triskelion Chapter is autonomous and is guided by City/Municipal Council and Provincial Council up to the Regional Council and/or Metropolitan Council they belong, thus, every individual Triskelion has a Chapter of origin where they came from. A Tau Gamma Phi member can also have an affiliated Chapter or Welcoming Chapter where each must comply with the residency requirements and Welcome Rites of the Welcoming Chapter. The difference of the basic Chapter from any other organizational body, is that the Chapters are source of decision in terms of governance, activities, man-power and initial resources
